title: Unlocking High Performance with Low-Bit NPUs and CPUs for Highly Optimized HPL-MxP on Cloud Brain II
problem: Existing HPL-MxP LU factorization algorithms optimize well on homogeneous systems but encounter difficulties on specialized heterogeneous NPU-CPU architectures due to inadequate optimization for computation, memory access, and communication patterns.
motivation: Mix-precision computation is essential for AI and scientific computing, but novel heterogeneous hardware architectures require specialized optimization approaches to effectively harness their computational capabilities.
method: The approach uses two strategies. First, it fuses multiple rounds of matrix multiplication (general matrix multiplication or GEMM) together and keeps intermediate results in the fastest on-chip memory (L1 buffer) to reduce the constant shuffling of data back and forth—this overcomes the memory wall, the bottleneck where data movement becomes slower than computation itself. Second, it builds a pipeline that splits work between two different processor types: specialized processors called NPUs (neural processing units) handle the heavy matrix multiplication work while regular CPUs handle the remaining parts of LU factorization (a matrix decomposition technique), allowing them to work together efficiently.
key_novelty: The core idea is combining multiple rounds of matrix multiplication into a fused operation while keeping intermediate results in fast on-chip memory (L1 buffer), designed specifically to eliminate data movement bottlenecks in systems mixing specialized processors (NPUs) with regular CPUs.
contributions: Algorithm-hardware co-optimization framework for mixed-precision LU factorization on heterogeneous NPU-CPU architectures
Novel multi-iteration GEMM fusion technique maximizing L1 buffer utilization to overcome memory wall bottlenecks
Multi-stage, multi-level heterogeneous pipeline orchestrating NPU offloading with CPU task handling for LU factorization
Performance validation demonstrating enhanced results through optimized CPU-accelerator collaboration

metrics.other: L1 buffer utilization and memory wall optimization

baselines: existing HPL-MxP algorithms on homogeneous systems
primary_theme: Mixed-precision LU factorization optimization on heterogeneous NPU-CPU systems
